messages:
Maya R.: Heads up — retrospective secret-scan flagged an RSA private key and an Azure SP secret in an archived Azure Pipelines build log from 2026-02-15.
Ethan L.: omg. where in the log?
Maya R.: snippet below (redacted here), looks like a script accidentally echoed env vars during deploy step:
```
[2026-02-15 03:12:10] export AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=3f8a...REDACTED...b4c
[2026-02-15 03:12:11] echo "AZ_CLIENT_SECRET=$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET"
```
Priya S.: Is that the service principal we use for staging infra?
Maya R.: yes, client id matches staging-sp-01. It had Contributor on /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/staging-rg.
Aaron K.: Immediate actions: revoke the SP creds, rotate, and remove Contributor role until we scope it down. I'll take revocation.
Chen Z.: Also need to rotate any KMS wrapping keys if they were used by that SP for backups — doing a quick check on key usage logs.
Priya S.: I'll open an SOC incident and start a timeline. filing INC-2026-042 now.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by Priya S. Severity P2. Notifying on-call.
Ethan L.: Aaron: run `az ad sp credential reset --id <sp-object-id> --years 1` or just delete existing creds?
Aaron K.: I'm deleting the active secret now and creating a new credential with a different description. Command I used: `az ad sp credential delete --id <sp-id> --key-id <key-id>` then `az ad sp credential reset --id <sp-id> --years 1 --append`.
Maya R.: Done. Confirmed old secret invalidated.
Chen Z.: RBAC change executed: removed Contributor role from staging-sp-01. We'll re-add least-privilege role (Storage Blob Data Contributor) later if needed.
Priya S.: Notes for comms: no external indicators of compromise found so far, no egress to suspicious IPs in the same window. Marking as contained for now.
Ethan L.: For longer term: move pipeline secrets to Key Vault and use service-managed identities instead of client secrets. Also enable pipeline log redaction.
Aaron K.: Agreed. I'll add a quick checklist: 1) Migrate secret variables to Key Vault-backed pipeline library, 2) Switch staging pipelines to use user-assigned managed identity, 3) Enable build log masking and retention 90d, 4) Add post-commit git-secrets hook.
Maya R.: Can someone run a repo-wide grep for patterns and also scan archived build logs? I want to know if other pipelines have similar echoes.
Ethan L.: Running `git grep -n "AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" -- \` now across repos and queueing the pipeline logs scan. Will feed results to INC-2026-042.
ops-bot: Archival log scan job started (job id: logscan-20260320-17). Estimated 45m.
Priya S.: Chen — any KMS exposure?
Chen Z.: KMS usage shows no wrap/unwrap by that SP in the flagged window. Still rolling a precautionary key rotation schedule for the affected keyVaults.
Maya R.: Good. For audit logging: we should ensure Key Vault access logs + Azure AD sign-in logs for SP are exported to our SIEM and kept for 1y.
Priya S.: I'll update the audit policy and raise a change request with GRC to record that.
Ethan L.: Also adding a pipeline lint rule to fail builds if `echo $AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET` or similar patterns are present.
Aaron K.: Security automation follow-ups: - add a GitHub Action/CI step to run git-secrets and trufflehog on PRs - enable repo write protection on main for infra repos - create a remediation runbook for this exact flow.
Maya R.: For the post-incident retro: assign owners, timeline, root cause (human script printed env var), and preventatives (KV + managed identity + masking + RBAC hardening). Priya — can you own the retro?
Priya S.: Yes, I'll coordinate. Scheduling a 30m retro tomorrow 10:00. Adding action items to the ticket.
sec-bot: Action item created: Rotate SP creds and update pipelines (owner: Aaron K., due: 2026-03-22).
Ethan L.: Scan results: found 2 other pipelines that echo secrets in old logs (pre-2026-01). Added them to the incident.
Maya R.: Okay, escalate to P1 if we find any public exposure or exfil logs. For now keep P2 and proceed with plan.
Aaron K.: After rotation, I'll deploy updated pipelines to staging and verify access with managed identity. Will post verification logs here.
Chen Z.: I'll follow up with KMS rotation confirmation and post audit entries once done.
Priya S.: Thank you all. We'll include communication to affected app owners and customer-facing teams if needed.
Maya R.: Great work — let's close the loop when all remediation tasks show green in INC-2026-042. :thumbsup:
